title: Writing / Style / Periods
slide_intent: Keep sentence endings visually predictable so readers can follow quoted material without distraction.
strategic_value: A compact punctuation comparison can help Duolingo maintain editorial consistency across writers.
demonstration: Two versions of a quoted sentence differ in whether the period sits inside or outside quotation marks.
practical_value: Check period placement and spacing when a sentence includes a quotation.

content_islands.name: Worked examples

reference_purposes.Application: The paired sentence places its period inside quotation marks in the preferred version.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Place periods inside quotation marks and follow periods with one space rather than two.
